caption: The drawing features a single, large brass or gold-toned candlestick rendered in color, positioned prominently in the lower right section of the image. The candlestick has a broad, square base tapering upward with several ridges, a rounded midsection, and a flared, circular top designed to hold a candle. To the left of the main candlestick, two black and white technical drawings provide additional views: one is a front elevation view, and below it, there is a top view depicting the square base with a central circular depression. Beneath these technical drawings, a small scale bar is shown, marked in increments of 0 to 3 inches. The background is light beige, and the entire composition is bounded by a thin, rectangular outline. The name "PHILIP JOHNSON" appears in small text at the bottom left corner of the drawing.
title: Candlestick
